setlist_extra.title: This Could Be The Last Time

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Stella Blue** (2 reviews): Jerry struggled through it, which was beautiful and left the reviewer tearful; Jerry's singing was heart wrenching; the reviewer hoped he could finish the song [9][10]
- **Jack Straw** (1 review): Strong rendition apart from a small lyric slip by Garcia [7]
- **Ramble On Rose** (1 review): Judged the first really good version of 1994 [11]
- **If The Shoe Fits** (1 other source): Uploader flags it as the first of this Lesh tune, credited to Lesh and Andrew Charles [1]
- **Dea..l** (1 review): Jerry forgot the lyrics, and the taper's section enthusiastically sang them for him [11]
- **The Last Time** (1 review): Reviewer says this version rips, as it usually does [7]
- **Box Of Rain** (1 review): The encore had the crowd singing as they left in search of shade [9]

## Setlist highlights

- **Dea..l**: cut on the recording [12]
- **NFA Chant..Encore Break**: back after 172 archived shows (952 days); rare: 10 archived performances [12]
- Earliest performances in the archive: If The Shoe Fits [12]

## The recordings

- **gd1994-06-09.Nak300CP4.Baker.Keo.119694.Flac1644** (recommended): audience recording; 18 songs; 150 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd94-06-09.schoeps.ladner.10066.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 17 songs; 155 min; rated 3.33/5 by 6 [3]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds this audience recording sweet and wishes soundboards existed for this run; Reviewer calls it probably the best audience recording from 1994 on the site [6][7]
- **gd1994-06-09.119146.sonicDSM1sx.d5scott.flac16**: source not stated; 17 songs; 127 min [4]
- **gd1994-06-09.Nak300CP4.Baker.Keo.119693.Flac2496**: audience recording; 18 songs; 150 min [2]

## Around the show

- Listener bathed in Shasta waters the day before, then drove into Sacramento's heat for the show [5]
- Every day of the run was very hot; the reviewer spent days in a pool [9]
- Reviewer missed Brent and wished Bruce Hornsby had stayed with the band longer [10]
- Called solid and consistent but ordinary, not among the band's best shows [5]
- The first set was short and slow; the China Cat/Rider opening the second set lifted the show [10]
- The second-set China Cat>Rider is called the best of the year so far [11]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1994-06-09.Nak300CP4.Baker.Keo.119694.Flac1644**: taped by Baker; transferred by Keo; source: Master Audience Nakamichi CM300/CP4 Shotguns>Sony D5>Dolby B On; Taper Mr. Baker,Transfer By Keo; Tapes:Maxell MX-S 90,100; Transfer With Nakamichi MR-1>Dolby… [1]. Also: Source recorded and shared by Baker, using Nak 300 CP4 microphones, in FLAC 16-bit [1]
- **gd94-06-09.schoeps.ladner.10066.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Paul B.; source: Audience: Schoeps CMC54's [3]
- **gd1994-06-09.119146.sonicDSM1sx.d5scott.flac16**: taped by D5Scott; transferred by D5Scott; source: Source: 2 Sonic Studio DSM-1S/x microphones (up front & center) > Sony TC-D5M - analog master cassettes [4]. Also: Filename points to a Sonic DSM1sx source, attributed to d5scott, in 16-bit FLAC [4]
- **gd1994-06-09.Nak300CP4.Baker.Keo.119693.Flac2496**: taped by Baker; transferred by Keo; source: Master Audience Nakamichi CM300/CP4 Shotguns>Sony D5>Dolby B On; Taper Mr. Baker,Transfer By Keo; Tapes:Maxell MX-S 90,100; Transfer With Nakamichi MR-1>Dolby… [2]
